regime_context: US thematic leadership is heavily concentrated in the AI/semiconductor complex (AI Infrastructure, WFE, Memory/HBM all rank top-3 and are trend-gate eligible), with an absorption of 0.31, breadth fraction 0.43 narrowing, and one_narrative=false — rotation is mid-cycle, not a confirmed handoff. The gate is validated on this market (gate_helps=true), so drawdown discipline is the one reliable leg; rank-IC is ~0 per backtest, so I treat ranks as a focus lens only. Track record (n=84, hit_rate 0.679, dir_accuracy 0.488) is a moderately sized, directionally weak sample — direction accuracy near coin-flip keeps conviction low across the board.
emerging_watch: Watching whether 'Semiconductor Equipment (WFE)' topples 'AI Infrastructure' as leader. The margin is currently 0.555 and WFE's crowding_z=1.01 is the caution. The observable that retires this watch is a confirmed handoff: WFE score exceeding AI Infrastructure score for 5 consecutive observations with WFE breadth holding above 0.85 and its crowding_z not rising further.

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: Memory/HBM shows the cleanest trend-health profile among top-3 leaders: hurst_tag=trend (only one in the top three with a pure 'trend' tag), durability_bar=0.66 above its own trend-gate threshold and eligible=true, breadth=0.5, and crowding_z=0.22 (uncrowded versus WFE at 1.01). This is a durability/trend-gate leg lean, not a rank call — the absolute-trend gate is the only validated risk-control leg and Memory is trend-eligible without the crowding caution flagging the adjacent semi names.
evidence: rank 3 score 1.468 — leadership, but I lean on trend-gate + crowding texture, not rank
theses.dissent: Breadth is only 0.5 — half the theme is not participating, so the trend may be narrow leadership by one or two HBM names rather than a durable complex-wide move; a single large-cap reversal would drag the proxy.

falsifier.text: SMH fails to make a new 20-day high while Memory/HBM breadth drops below 0.3 before the check-by date

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity is the strongest breadth-and-durability combination in the ranks: breadth=1.0, durability_bar=0.81 (highest among top-10), hurst_tag=trend, eligible=true. The trend gate is validated on this market, and CIBR has a distinct proxy (not shared with the crowded semi complex). This is a trend-gate + breadth leg lean. Crowding_z=1.91 is a size-down caution only, not a fade.
evidence: CIBR unique proxy, avoids shared-SMH concentration
theses.dissent: crowding_z=1.91 is the highest in the top tier — if the theme is attention-saturated, forward returns are historically poor even with strong trend health; this is precisely the crowding flag the guardrails warn about.

falsifier.text: CIBR underperforms SPY by 3% while its breadth measure drops below 0.7 before the check-by date

theses.subject: Silver Miners
theses.thesis: Silver Miners is ineligible (eligible=false) with durability_bar=0.13, hurst_tag=mean-revert, and breadth=0.125. The absolute-trend gate — the one validated leg — explicitly excludes it, which on a gate_helps=true market is a drawdown-avoidance signal. This is a pure trend-gate leg avoid, not a short or fade; I express it as avoidance rather than underweight because the proxy is scorable but the leg that matters (gate) says stay out.
theses.dissent: Mean-reverting assets can bounce hard when the eligible trend complex corrects; avoidance misses that optionality if a sharp risk-off rotation into precious metals occurs.

falsifier.text: SIL closes above its 50-day moving average and stays there for 10 consecutive trading days before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
